title.en: the denver bloody mary festival at reelworks.
title.de: das denver bloody mary festival im reelworks.

line.en: unlimited bloody marys from local bars and one people's choice vote. general entry from 12:15, vip from 11:30. 21+ only.
line.de: unbegrenzt bloody marys von lokalen bars und eine stimme für den people's choice. einlass ab 12:15, vip ab 11:30. nur ab 21.
line.tr: yerel barlardan sınırsız bloody mary ve people's choice için bir oy. genel giriş 12:15, vip 11:30'dan. yalnızca 21 yaş ve üstü.

sparks.why: The tenth annual Denver Bloody Mary Festival, Sun 8 Nov 11:30-14:30 at Reelworks Denver, 1399 35th St (thebloodymaryfest.com and Eventbrite; Denver Gazette).
